title: ugni myricoides
intro: Ugni myricoides, commonly known as Chilean guava or Uñi, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which provide several health benefits, including the protection against oxidative stress, the reduction of inflammation, and the prevention of infections. The therapeutic actions of Ugni myricoides include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antioxidant, and an antimicrobial agent, making it effective in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Ugni myricoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
